name: Share leads and updates with referral partners
summary: Takes leads that partners refer into the business's pipeline, keeps each referring partner in the partner list, and queues a receipt and stage updates for that partner. Crons read and draft; a person approves every tag or contact change that reaches a partner.

covered_by.referral-received: intake (Pipedrive lead with the referral label)
covered_by.outcome-feedback: progress (the tag for a won or lost stage)
covered_by.track-referrals: intake and progress (store and Pipedrive deal link)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Referred leads from Pipedrive, each recorded once.

crons.name: acknowledge
crons.summary: Queue one receipt per new referral for a person to approve.

crons.name: progress
crons.summary: Queue a stage tag for the partner when a referred deal reaches a mapped stage.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. Pipedrive is never written by this workflow. Every ActiveCampaign write reaches a partner through the business's automation, so each one is a live operation and waits for a person.

pipedrive.covers: referred leads, one lead, deals changed since a time (reads)

activecampaign.covers: partner contact lookup, contact sync with tag, tag on an existing contact

gaps: Mailchimp was checked and not built: its partner steps are mailing lists and campaigns, not a lead pipeline, and its qualify step is marked no.
The kit has no adapter for it, so it is not built.
Sharing lead details with a partner (share-lead-details) is not built. Neither Pipedrive nor ActiveCampaign describes sending lead detail to an outside partner, so this is a person's call for now.
Partner review per partner is not built. Pipedrive and ActiveCampaign report conversion for pipelines overall, not per referrer.
The partner emails are not written here. The business builds an ActiveCampaign automation that sends on the acknowledged tag and on each stage tag. This workflow only applies the tags.
The partner email is read from a lead or deal custom field whose 40-character key goes in settings. Confirm the field name and value in the client's own Pipedrive account before turning the crons on.

Intake and acknowledge read one page of 100 leads per run, and progress reads one page of 100 deals per run. A busier account needs paging. A referred lead converted to a deal before an intake run is missed.
Pipedrive's own automations can send email to a partner outside this workflow. This workflow does not check them.
Referral fees, thank-you rewards, AML checks and consent capture are judgment or business process, not automated. The platform pages do not describe them.
Both adapters are docs-only until a sandbox account for each proves them. The kit has no runtime change to request.
